opportunities.title: Community Partnerships Intern
opportunities.description: Back to Previous Opportunity Details Community Partnerships Intern Keep Orlando Beautiful 0 similar opportunities Similar Opportunities Description Keep Orlando Beautiful is searching for a Community Partnerships Intern to assist in securing new community partnerships for ongoing community efforts, including litter cleanups and public school STEM education projects. This position is for the Fall semester with flexible dates depending on intern availability. This internship will run for a 12-week term with flexible start and end dates. This is an unpaid volunteer opportunity and may be eligible for college credit. It is the student''s responsibility to arrange college credit with their institution. Community Partnerships Intern daily activities include: Assist the Keep Orlando Beautiful team by engaging local organizations and identifying potential community partners. Follow-up and arrange meetings with community partners to identify type of partnership. Such as corporate volunteer, sponsor, or event collaboration. Learn and stay up to date on Keep Orlando Beautiful programs and events to share with new community partners. Develop a community partner database to track outreach in collaboration with Keep Orlando Beautiful staff. Prepare and assist with upcoming events including community cleanups, workshops, and our annual fundraiser Trash 2 Trends. Answer and direct incoming emails and calls. Assist with other duties as assigned. Professionally represent the Keep Orlando Beaut

Join us on Mondays and/or Thursdays at South Street Urban Farm to get your hands dirty, learn new skills, and help build a more sustainable community. Each week, we''ll be processing food scraps collected from a local community organization. Volunteers will help chop food waste, mix it with mulch, and load it into our onsite composter. opportunities.title: CERT Volunteers - Community Emergency Response Team
opportunities.description: Back to Previous Opportunity Details CERT Volunteers - Community Emergency Response Team Orlando Fire Department 0 similar opportunities Similar Opportunities Description Position: The Community Emergency Response Team (CERT) program educates volunteers about disaster preparedness for the hazards that may occur where they live. CERT trains volunteers in basic disaster response skills, such as: Fire safety Light search and rescue Team organization Disaster medical operations The CERT program offers a consistent, nationwide approach to volunteer training and organization that professional responders can rely on during disaster situations, allowing them to focus on more complex tasks. Qualifications: Volunteers must complete a mandatory CERT Basic Training either online or in-person in order to be CERT certified. Volunteers will also need to complete and pass a background screening prior to beginning their service. Responsibilities: Once CERT trained, volunteers will have the opportunity to participate in community events focused on safety and disaster preparedness.
